push notification.note: Established rendering per community rules and Weblate glossary; never 'notification poussée'. Plural: 'notifications push'.

notification sound.note: No existing translation yet for the incoming-call setting.

share extension.note: Matches Apple's French terminology for share extensions.

bottom sheet.note: No existing translation; mostly a translator-facing term. 'bottom sheet' may be kept in developer contexts.

long-press.note: Existing tutorial string uses 'Appuyez longtemps sur…'; noun form: 'appui long'.

tap.note: Standard French mobile convention ('Appuyez sur…'); existing strings inconsistently use 'cliquez' or 'pression' — prefer 'appuyer' on touch UIs.

toast.note: Kept in English (masculine), as in French Android documentation; rarely user-facing.

clipboard.note: With final 's' (invariable); existing strings mix 'presse-papier' and 'presse-papiers' — prefer 'presse-papiers'.

passcode.note: Matches Apple's French term for the device passcode.

jailbroken.note: Existing: 'dispositifs jailbreakés'. Cover 'rooted' with 'jailbreakés ou rootés' when both appear.

app logs.note: No existing translation yet; 'journal' is the standard rendering of 'log' ('niveau de journalisation' on desktop).

deep link.note: Microsoft French terminology; 'deep link' is sometimes kept in developer contexts.

skin tone.note: Majority in existing emoji strings; 'teinte de peau' also appears once — prefer 'couleur de peau'.

server connection.note: Add a server: 'Ajouter un serveur' (existing); Switch server: 'Changer de serveur'.
